name: kindle
notes: Kindle for Mac. Open the book yourself and run with --no-open. Pages turn with the right arrow key. Choose a single-column layout and a fixed font size in the reader settings before capturing; the app renders the next page slightly after the key press, which the settle check absorbs. The reader exposes no accessibility elements, so a page where Vision finds no text (blank page, full-page image) is reported by Peekaboo as ACCESSIBILITY_INCOMPLETE and recorded as an empty page.
